title: InsuranceClaimExtractionSchema
description: Strict schema for healthcare insurance claims extracted from medical forms.

claim_id.description: Unique insurance claim reference identifier starting with CLM-.

policy_number.description: Active policyholder account number starting with POL-.

patient_name.description: Full legal name of the receiving patient.

hospital_name.description: Name of medical institution or clinic providing care.

admission_date.description: Hospital check-in or treatment date in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

claim_amount.description: Total requested reimbursement claim amount in policy currency.

diagnosis_code.description: Standardized World Health Organization ICD-10 medical diagnostic code.
